topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I found a time capsule in my backyard this morning, tucked under an old oak tree where the roots weave through the soil like Nature’s own fingers. It’s a metal box, rusted over and sealed tight. I don’t recall burying it, and there’s no note or mark to suggest who did. I’ve set it aside for now, thinking it might be best to open it with someone who can help make sense of its contents. There’s a quiet intrigue about it, a story locked away that’s eager to be told.
